title: RiskAssessment
description: Risk Agent output for one applicable point. §46-56, §53 (example). RECONSTRUCTED from the architecture doc — diff against the actual locked RiskAssessment.json before use. Only exists for point_status='applicable' points; not_applicable and prohibited points are never scored (§29, §37.2).

baseline_score.description: Deterministic score from §48, before any LLM adjustment.

adjustment_reason.description: Required whenever llm_adjustment is non-zero; must reference an actual evidence field. §51.2

official_warnings.description: Applicable official warnings that set a floor. Empty array if none applied. §49

hard_rules_applied.description: Triggered hard safety rules. Empty array if none applied. §50

constraint_floor.description: max(official_warning_floor, hard_rule_floor) — the floor final_score can never go below. §51.3

hourly_scores.description: Per-hour baseline+floor scores across the interpreted window, retained for best-time selection (§63.1) and charts (§83). Required per §48.4 and the §53 field list, though omitted from the doc's own abbreviated JSON example — flagging that as a doc inconsistency.

llm_interpretation_unavailable.description: True when the Risk LLM failed validation twice and ORCA fell back to baseline+floors with template reasoning. §56.5
